cover.headline: MAKING VIDEO CORRECTIONS STICK
cover.alt: Three sculptural silver film frames stand on a charcoal editing table; an amber correction line resolves into teal registration marks on the final frame. The headline reads Making Video Corrections Stick, with Framewright Studio Notes 04 above it.
cover.full_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original landscape editorial blog cover, 16:9.
Primary request: Create a polished restrained editorial cover about preserving useful video corrections between productions. An original conceptual image, not a screenshot, video thumbnail or software advertisement.
Scene/backdrop: deep charcoal studio darkness with subtle tactile paper grain.
Subject: on the right, a sculptural silver film ribbon forms three distinct picture frames over a matte graphite editing table. A fine amber correction stroke travels across the first frame and resolves into a precise teal registration/anchor mark on the final frame. The final frame sits visibly and solidly on the table, with a believable contact shadow. One small inset frame nested within it suggests retaining context during reframing. Quiet, crafted materials, no clutter.
Style/medium: cinematic editorial still life, refined 3D objects mixed with delicate printed annotation marks; elegant, purposeful, no generic AI robot.
Composition/framing: wide landscape. Large clear headline in the left 55 percent, illustration on the right. Generous margins; readable at 480 px wide.
Lighting/mood: soft silver rim light, very restrained teal and amber glows, deep but readable darks.
Color palette: charcoal, ivory, silver, muted teal, amber.
Text (verbatim): "MAKING VIDEO
CORRECTIONS
STICK"
Series/issue label (verbatim): "FRAMEWRIGHT STUDIO NOTES 04"
Constraints: Render all text exactly as given. Use bold sophisticated condensed editorial sans serif for headline, ivory, high contrast. Small uppercase series label above headline, still readable. No other words, no watermarks, no logos, no invented metrics. Headline dominates without covering illustration. Completely original composition. Landscape 16:9.
